# Independently generated Studio descriptor

`studio-color.xml` is the exact payload downloaded from asset 79124565054263,
generated by Studio 0.740.19.7400931 when Jason published the private
RobloxToolchain Acceptance experience on September 25, 2026. Its single cyan
image is original synthetic acceptance content, asset 105842817222628.

SHA-256: `4d944172307e81b5eae1cd515afec105220b59a62f28787434167b868d84bc57`.
There is no trailing newline. No credentials or signed delivery URLs are retained.

The offline regression substitutes the image reference with a local content URI
and verifies the rest of our encoder output exactly. This establishes the native
descriptor layout independently of our writer; it does not prove that a particular
renderer consumes a pack or that cloud delivery preserves other asset formats.
